blocks.content: JavaScript provides built-in methods to work with object keys, values, and entries:

items: Object.keys() – Retrieve all keys of the object as an array.
Object.values() – Retrieve all values of the object as an array.
Object.entries() – Retrieve all key-value pairs as an array of arrays.
